settings.title: Settings
settings.account.footer: Magic-link sign-in, sign-out, and account deletion.
settings.recovery.intro.cloud: On a new iPhone, recovering encrypted reflection notes takes two steps: sign in with the same email, then enter the recovery password you set here. Streaks sync with sign-in alone; notes stay locked without the password.
settings.recovery.intro.local: This device keeps data local. A recovery password unlocks reflection notes on this iPhone. To move everything to a new phone, export an encrypted backup below.
settings.recovery.footer.local_backup: Encrypted backup is the way to move local data to another device.
settings.recovery.ready: You’re set for cloud recovery on a new phone.
settings.recovery.not_ready: Complete both steps above for cloud recovery.
settings.recovery.step.sign_in.hint: Opens account sign-in with a magic link.
settings.recovery.step.sign_in.detail.ne: Required — syncs streaks and encrypted note data to your account.
settings.recovery.step.password.detail.s: Set — save it in a password manager.
settings.recovery.step.password.detail.n: Required — decrypts reflection notes on a new phone.
settings.recovery.password_after_sign_in: Sign in first, then set a recovery password below.
settings.recovery.unlock_on_device: Enter your recovery password to view encrypted notes on this device.
settings.setup.replay.footer: Reopens the onboarding flow. Your data and settings stay on this device.
settings.on_iphone.peace: Peace break re-enables app shields instead of holding notifications. Use Focus in Settings for notification quiet.
settings.shields.edit_apps.hint: Opens Apple’s Screen Time picker to change what Morning Guard blocks during your morning window.
settings.shields.not_authorized: Screen Time isn’t authorized. Run the setup guide again to allow Morning Guard to shield apps.
settings.shields.help: Tap shielded apps above to change your selection. To fully remove shields, revoke Screen Time access for Morning Guard in Settings → Screen Time.
onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome to Morning Guard
onboarding.welcome.subtitle: Start your day with intention. On iPhone we shield apps you pick—not other apps’ notifications.
onboarding.welcome.gate.detail: Protect your first hours with Screen Time shields.
onboarding.welcome.no_digest.detail: iOS cannot hold or summarize notifications from other apps. Use Focus in Settings if you need quiet alerts.
onboarding.welcome.control.detail: Peace break, emergency passphrase, and local encrypted backup.
onboarding.data.title: Your data
onboarding.data.subtitle: Sync streaks and highlights with a magic link, or keep everything on this iPhone only.
onboarding.data.subtitle_signed_in: You’re signed in. Keep syncing to the cloud or switch to this device only (signs you out).
onboarding.data.local.title: Keep on this device
onboarding.data.local.detail: No account. Export an encrypted backup from Settings anytime.
onboarding.data.local.detail_signed_in: Turns off cloud sync and signs you out on this phone. Use encrypted local backup in Settings when you want a copy.
onboarding.data.cloud.title: Syncing to cloud
onboarding.data.cloud.detail_format: Stay signed in%1$@. Streaks and highlights sync across devices.
onboarding.data.email.hint: Finish setup now—open the link on this iPhone when it arrives. Delivery can take a few minutes.
onboarding.screentime.title: Screen Time access
onboarding.screentime.subtitle: Morning Guard uses Apple’s Screen Time API to shield apps you pick until you finish your morning goal.
onboarding.screentime.simulator: Simulator: authorization isn’t required. Shields only work on a physical device.
onboarding.screentime.self_control: Self-control on your device—not parental monitoring.
onboarding.apps.title: Apps to shield
onboarding.apps.subtitle: Pick distractions to limit during your morning window. Apple’s picker usually lists apps inside categories (Social, Games, etc.)—not system apps like Phone. Don’t add Morning Guard; you need it to finish your goal.
onboarding.apps.simulator: Simulator: the app picker may be empty. You can continue without selecting apps.
onboarding.apps.need_auth: Authorize Screen Time on the previous step to choose apps.
onboarding.apps.choose.hint: Opens the Screen Time picker to select apps, categories, or websites to shield.
onboarding.apps.none_selected: Nothing selected yet. Tap below to open Apple’s picker, then choose apps or categories—skip Morning Guard itself.
onboarding.apps.unavailable: Family Controls unavailable in this build.
onboarding.routine.title: Your morning routine
onboarding.routine.subtitle: When this window is active and your goal isn’t done, selected apps stay shielded.
onboarding.routine.hint.bible: John 1 by default. Stay on the goal screen for about 60 seconds.
onboarding.routine.hint.timed: Stay on the goal screen until the timer finishes (default 2 minutes).
onboarding.routine.hint.steps: Counts steps via HealthKit; Simulator may not update steps.
onboarding.routine.simulator_tip: Tip: set the window to include now, then finish onboarding and tap Start morning goal on Home.
onboarding.focus.title: Quiet mornings with Focus
onboarding.focus.subtitle: Morning Guard shields apps; Focus helps silence notifications. You set both in iOS Settings—we can’t turn Focus on for you.
onboarding.focus.card.shields_detail: During your morning window, apps you chose stay blocked until you finish your goal.
onboarding.focus.body: Open Settings → Focus and schedule a morning Focus for the same hours as your routine. That quiets notifications while you read or pray.
onboarding.emergency.title: Emergency bypass
onboarding.emergency.subtitle: Optional. Set a passphrase now or later in Settings for a one-hour unlock during emergencies.
onboarding.magic_link.sent: Magic link sent. Open it on this iPhone when it arrives.

account.intro: We email you a magic link — open it on this iPhone to finish signing in. Pair this with your recovery password in Sync & recovery for full note recovery on a new device.
account.unconfigured: Cloud sync is not configured in this build.
account.sync_enabled: Streaks and highlights sync while cloud sync is enabled.
account.magic_link.footer: Open the link on this iPhone. Check spam if it does not arrive within a minute.
account.inbox.tap_link: Tap the link in the email to finish signing in.
account.delete_confirm.title: Delete account?
account.delete_confirm.message: This permanently deletes your Morning Guard account and cloud data. Local streaks and highlights on this device will be cleared.
account.rate_limit_format: Please wait %1$lld seconds before requesting another link.
account.link_sent_format: We sent a link to %1$@. Open it on this iPhone.

settings.notes.intro: Reflection notes are always encrypted on this device (Keychain). Set a recovery password to open them after reinstall or on a new phone.
settings.notes.recovery_not_set: Recovery password: not set — notes cannot be recovered on a new device
settings.notes.rules: Use at least 8 characters with a letter and a number. Save it in a password manager.
settings.notes.saved: Recovery password saved. Store it in a password manager.
settings.backup.intro: Encrypted backup includes highlights, streaks, and settings on this device (not a cloud export).
settings.backup.restore_message: Restore replaces settings, streaks, highlights, and goal progress on this device. This cannot be undone.
settings.backup.choose_save: Choose where to save the backup file.
settings.backup.restored_unlock: Backup restored. Unlock highlight notes in Settings with your notes password.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.screentime: Morning Guard on iPhone uses Apple’s Screen Time APIs to shield apps you choose during your morning window. It does not read, hold, or summarize notifications from other apps (unlike Android’s digest).
privacy.healthkit: Morning Guard may read step counts through HealthKit when you choose a step goal. Step data is used only on this device to verify your goal.
privacy.cloud: If you enable cloud sync, streak and highlight metadata sync through Supabase under your account. Highlight reflection notes are encrypted on device; only ciphertext syncs when you set a recovery password.
privacy.web_link: Full privacy policy on the web
a11y.privacy.title: Privacy policy
recovery.start_fresh.title: Start fresh on this phone?
recovery.start_fresh.message: Notes encrypted with your old recovery password cannot be opened without that password. Your cloud data will not be deleted, but this device will create new notes with a new key. Only continue if you accept losing access to older cloud notes.
recovery.blocking.intro: Your account has encrypted notes from another device. Enter your recovery password to open them here.
recovery.blocking.forgot: Forgot password? Start fresh on this device
recovery.blocking.title: Enter recovery password
recovery.dedicated.title: Protect your notes on a new phone
recovery.dedicated.body: You’re signed in for cloud sync. Reflection notes are encrypted — on a new iPhone you’ll need this recovery password (plus the same email sign-in) to open them.
recovery.dedicated.later: Later — I may lose notes on a new phone
